text: CalIcsParser.parseFromStream now reads an unconverted byte string and detects its charset with MailStringUtils.detectCharset, decodes it with byteStringToString and then parses calendar text. MailStringUtils recognizes byte-order marks before using its encoding detector. CalIcsImporter delegates to that parser rather than forcing UTF-8 through a converter input stream. Preserve the bytes until the decoding decision. This tolerant import behavior does not mean all legacy encodings are preferred for newly written ICS files.
title: Read calendar file bytes before detecting their character encoding
